about: Manual rulings for scripts/import-sermons.php. Key: the source ID of a harvested item. Value: {"same_as": "<source ID already imported>"} to add it to that sermon, {"action": "new"} to create its own sermon, or {"action": "skip"} to leave it out. Add "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" to correct the service date the post gave. Add a note saying who decided and why.
